items.claim: Padilla has good ground and pound with effective elbows from half guard.
items.quote: Good top control predict predominantly from his half guard position. He'll get top half guard and just kind of sneak some elbows up, right?

items.claim: Hack Press has high striking output and comes forward throwing many shots.
items.quote: hack press kind of just does this thing where he comes forward and throws a lot of shots and starts countering while he's coming forward.

items.claim: Elise Reed has a taekwondo style with low hands.
items.quote: Elise Reed, good striking, right? She's got that taekwondo style... she's got her hands low

items.claim: Elise Reed is able to take a punch well despite her low hands.
items.quote: the girl can take a punch. So sometimes that doesn't really cause her a problem

items.claim: Elise Reed's takedown defense is not great.
Elise Reed has good cardio and is able to get back up in later rounds.
items.quote: the girls got cardio, so you better be ready for her to get back up in the next round

items.claim: Channel Dyer has a good jab and heavy leg kicks.
items.quote: she's got a good jab that she'll like to stick that right through the middle. Heavy heavy leg kick.

items.claim: Channel Dyer has surprising takedown ability for a kickboxer.
items.quote: She's got a surprising takedown ability for someone who's essentially a kickboxer

items.claim: Kennedy Nzechukwu has good power and a great kicking game for a heavyweight, but low output.
items.quote: He's got power. He's got good knees up the middle. The kicking game for a heavyweight is actually great. but the output is usually pretty bad
He does seem to lack urgency just everywhere. And that's my biggest problem with with Kennedy is he just lacks urgency.

items.claim: Shamil Gaziev keeps his hands down and eats punches.
items.quote: he'll keep his hands down and he just kind of eats punches.

items.claim: Shamil Gaziev's cardio fades badly if he is forced to wrestle.
items.quote: his cardio fades really bad if you force him to wrestle
